messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

sentences: The loop runs three times because k starts at 1 and goes up to 3 on its own.
Since k is 1, 2, 3 and then stops, fire gets called three times.
When k equals 2 it just skips ahead, so the count stays three shots.
The while keeps going while k is small, and k handles its own increase.
Starting at one and ending at three means three fires happen in the loop.
